versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the seo-content skill for content quality, E-E-A-T, and AI citation readiness analysis.
- Provides Google-aligned heuristics for "Who/How/Why" content evaluation and updated E-E-A-T (including Sept 2025 QRG).
- Adds in-depth metrics for word count, readability, keyword usage, structure, and linking best practices.
- Introduces AI content quality checks and citation optimization for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity).
- Includes up-to-date references to Google’s latest algorithm changes and official documentation as of June 2026.
